limitations: OSM boundary definitions and government statistical area definitions differ.
A point-in-polygon pass proves membership only, not shape accuracy along every boundary.
Map vector tile quantization and source footprint errors persist. Height source proxies are not per-building survey measurements.
Display boundary omits distant source relation members/farms outside the Shanghai focus rectangle; unmodified source geometry is preserved.
Road elevations, bridges, building facades and interiors need separate validation.
